text: The richest man in Babylon on why luck skips most people.
Arkad's students asked how to attract fortune. One talked about finding a purse. Another, the races.
Arkad's answer on betting: those games are built so the house wins, not the player.
Then a trader told his story. Late one night, he was offered a whole flock of sheep at a low price.
He decided to wait until morning. By sunrise, other buyers had come, and the price had jumped.
Nobody stole the deal from him. Hesitation did.
"Opportunity is a haughty goddess who wastes no time with those who are unprepared."
